messages:
miguel: grafana alert: remote_write p95 latency > 8s in ap-sg, a bunch of 504s showing up. dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/alerts/12345 :frowning:
prom-bot: ALERT -> remote_write_latency_p95 (ap-sg) triggered by prometheus-ap-sg-01
anya: any config changes in the last 24h? or a rollout? :eyes:
sam: rolled gpu-autoscaler v2 yesterday afternoon to reduce binpacking. noticed more short-lived nodes since then.
olivia: I can see a matching spike in NAT gateway open connections and conntrack entries hitting high in ap-sg. looks like many short-lived scrape targets.
katie: grabbing prometheus logs now, tail:
```
level=warn ts=2026-03-20T10:12:03Z caller=client.go:234 component=remote level=warn err="Post \"https://remote-write.redwood:443/api/v1/write\": net/http: request canceled (Client.Timeout exceeded while awaiting headers)"
```
miguel: that matches the 504s. suspect cardinality + many ephemeral targets > connection pool + NAT ephemeral ports exhaustion.
anya: could be autoprovisioned GPU nodes creating tasks with unique label `gpu_id` per pod. cardinality explosion.
sam: yes the autoscaler attaches `gpu_serial` label to each nodepool instance now. that label got passed through relabeling by mistake.
olivia: quick mitigation: add a relabel_config to drop `gpu_serial` before sending to remote_write and reduce `scrape_timeout` for the noisy exporters.
katie: proposed relabel snippet (prometheus config):
```
- source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_gpu_serial]
  action: drop
  regex: .+
```
also set `scrape_timeout: 5s` for exporter jobs that are noisy.
miguel: any risk to dropping gpu_serial? we lose per-GPU telemetry but saves cluster-level SLOs.
sam: acceptable for now. we keep it in local metrics for debugging but not in global remote_write.
anya: steps I can run now:
1) patch prometheus configmap in monitoring namespace with relabel rule
2) trigger prometheus reload
3) temporarily scale down prometheus remote_write concurrency (max_shards) to reduce burst
4) open a ticket to change autoscaler to stop exposing per-instance serial as pod label

olivia: also adding a NAT gateway pool scaling request to infra. may need ephemeral natgw for burst windows.
katie: applying patch now:
```
kubectl -n monitoring patch configmap prometheus-server --patch '"data": {"prometheus.yml": "...add relabel..."}' && kubectl -n monitoring exec deploy/prometheus -- kill -HUP 1
```
prom-bot: deployment event -> prometheus configmap updated by katie at 2026-03-20T10:18:41Z
sam: after patch checking remote_write queue length and p95.
miguel: initial numbers look better, p95 down to ~1.8s, remote_write errors decreasing.
anya: followup: create a durable relabel rule in the helm chart and a change in autoscaler repo to stop passing `gpu_serial`. ticket INF-412 assigned.
olivia: opened NATGW scaling PR: https://git.redwood/infra/natgw/pull/78
katie: will monitor for 2 hours and then revert any temporary scrape_timeout changes if safe. :thumbsup:
miguel: great work team. leaving this thread open until metrics stable for 30m.
